next.reason: §1985:VII.3.2.2, the sequential file description entry, writes out BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD, LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF, DATA RECORDS, LINAGE and CODE-SET. Its 2023 counterpart is §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 1 (sequential)', which §2023:13.4.5.3 SR5 names ('Format 1 is the file description entry for a sequential file'); it writes BLOCK CONTAINS and CODE-SET in line and takes the RECORD and LINAGE clauses by reference to §2023:13.18.43.2 and §2023:13.18.34.2. It has no LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause (in 1985 the subjects of §1985:VII.3.2.4 GR2, 'the DATA RECORDS clause, the LABEL RECORDS clause'), so a 1985 FD using them is refused; it also adds FORMAT and a wider CODE-SET. A compile-time difference, no exception condition: CHANGED. The clause-order rule carries its own record (1985 SR2). The BLOCK CONTAINS and CODE-SET clauses Format 1 writes in line are restated by their own clause formats, §2023:13.18.10.2 and §2023:13.18.13.2, which therefore state part of the entry's syntax too.
